question: What was revenue in September 2025?
timeSemantics: calendar month in 2025; use the metric time dimension
permissionRequirements: persona may access the requested scope
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(il.amount) - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM refunds r JOIN invoices ri ON ri.invoice_id=r.invoice_id WHERE ri.status='posted'),0),2) AS value FROM invoice_lines il JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=il.invoice_id WHERE i.status='posted' AND i.recognized_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-09-30'

question: What is our current ARR as of December 31, 2025?
timeSemantics: calendar month in 2025; use the metric time dimension
permissionRequirements: persona may access the requested scope
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.annual_price),2) AS value FROM subscriptions s JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id=s.plan_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=s.account_id WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AND (s.canceled_at IS NULL OR s.canceled_at > DATE '2025-12-31') AND a.test_account=FALSE

question: How many active customers did we have on December 31, 2025?

question: What was our conversion rate in September 2025?

question: Which product generated the most recognized revenue in 2025?
timeSemantics: calendar month in 2025; use the metric time dimension
permissionRequirements: persona may access the requested scope
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(il.amount),2) AS value FROM invoice_lines il JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=il.invoice_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=il.product_id WHERE i.status='posted' AND i.recognized_at BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is average order value by region in 2025?
timeSemantics: calendar month in 2025; use the metric time dimension
permissionRequirements: persona may access the requested scope
sql: SELECT r.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity*oi.unit_price)/COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id),2) AS value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=o.account_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id=a.billing_region_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY r.name

question: How many accounts purchased more than one product in 2025?

sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM (SELECT o.account_id FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY o.account_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id)>1) x

question: Which plan has the highest refund rate in 2025?
timeSemantics: calendar month in 2025; use the metric time dimension
permissionRequirements: persona may access the requested scope
sql: SELECT p.name, ROUND(SUM(r.amount)/NULLIF(SUM(il.amount),0),4) AS value FROM refunds r JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_id=r.invoice_id JOIN invoice_lines il ON il.invoice_id=i.invoice_id JOIN subscriptions s ON s.account_id=i.account_id JOIN plans p ON p.plan_id=s.plan_id WHERE r.refund_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was recognized revenue by sales rep in 2025?

question: Which product contributed most to increased refunds in 2025?

question: What drove the increase in churn in 2025?
